description: Advises assessing efficacy and safety at least monthly for the first 3 months, then at least every 3 months for all patients prescribed weight‑loss medications. Triggers include clinician questions such as “How often should I check progress after starting orlistat?” or “What is the follow‑up schedule for a patient on liraglutide?”.
